Coverage_Description: Single-premium participating life plan with lifetime coverage; guaranteed cash value starts at 85% of single premium and grows with non-guaranteed terminal bonus; death benefit (if no backup insured) is the higher of guaranteed cash value + terminal bonus or 101% of single premium, less outstanding loans
pricing: Single premium (lump sum); minimum US$10,000. Illustrated case uses US$1,000,000 single premium.
customer requirement: Insured must be at least 15 days old at application signing; applications/changes are subject to insurer approval and underwriting requirements
price structure: Single-pay; nominal amount equals the single premium
additional informations: USD policy currency; no medical exam if total single premium is within company administrative limit; bonus lock-in from policy year 10 (10%-50% each time, total up to 50%)
